test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

We should not __discriminate__ against people who are different from us
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. differentiate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"discriminate"** means to make an unjust or prejudicial distinction in the treatment of different categories of people or things, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex. (भेदभाव करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company was accused of discriminating against older workers.
 
 
 
• **"Differentiate" **refers to recognizing or ascertaining what makes someone or something different. (अंतर करना)
 
 
• **Example: **It is important to differentiate between fact and opinion.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym for **'discriminate' **is **'differentiate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. differentiate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Part **(भाग): A piece or segment of something.

 
 
• **Example:** This is just one part of a much larger project.
 
 
 
• **Sever **(काटना): To cut off or separate.
 
 
• **Example: **He severed all ties with his family.
 
 
 
• **Divide** (विभाजित करना): To separate into parts or groups.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher divided the class into groups for the activity.
 
 

54:Ta67,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.<
